plan: Deep-copy the input into one private workspace tree and traverse nested item lists in deterministic list order.
Centralize recursive walking for word totals, unresolved-marker collection, outline rendering, and item lookup.
Validate every relocation completely before mutation, including identifiers, destination type, index bounds, and containment cycles.
Return independent deep copies from to_data() so callers cannot mutate internal state.
mechanisms: Recursive depth-first traversal over section/group item lists
Regex-based marker removal and word counting
Set accumulation followed by lexicographic sorting
